title: Sexteto Nacional and Alfredito Valdes
summary: Clarifying dates, he explains he replaced a maraca player at Sexteto Nacional, then moved to Maria Teresa and then Agabama, and talks of Alfredito Valdes.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: All right. You were with Agabama from thirty-three to thirty-six?
Okay. When did you sing with Nacional?

Nacional? From 1929 to about six months with the Sexteto Nacional, because Bienvenido Leon, he don't know how to play the maracas, he was a singer, beautiful baritone voice, and they need a maraca player because a sextet/is very important instrument. So in account that they saw me playing at the Agabama, because I was replacing Machin, that he went to sing to a private party, with Miguel Zavayas. Ignacio Pineiro saw me playing the maracas, so I went - he told me "I want you to go to the Havana Sport, that was the academy, Havana Sport. So I went out there, played maracas hor him and I played about six months. That's when I went from Sexteto Nacional to Maria Teresa in 1930.
Oh, I see. So the first one then was Nacional.
Okay. Had you already met Alfredito Valdes?
I knew Alfredito when he was a kid.

No, we worked together at the Miguel Zavayas, he was the bass player. Another first voice was El Mejicano and then Alfredito Valdes went to the Sexteto Nacional; and Panchito Riset, that the the place for Alfredito Valdes ...
I see. Okay, Alfredito Valdes joined the band after Cheo Jimenez died.
Right? Okay. Now, you left you went from Sexteto Nacional to ......
...and then from Maria Teresa to Agabama.
